features.title: Board model and FEN
features.user_visible_behavior: The engine can load and export Makruk positions in FEN, starting from rnsmksnr/8/pppppppp/8/8/PPPPPPPP/8/RNSKMSNR w - - 0 1.
verification: Unit tests: parse → serialize round-trips for the start position and 10+ varied positions.
Invalid FEN inputs are rejected with typed errors.
evidence: 2026-09-13: packages/engine/src/fen.test.ts — 12 round-trip positions (start, counting fields, promoted M~, repetition clock) + missing-field defaults pass; 17 invalid FEN cases throw FenError.
2026-09-13: reference.test.ts lock-step games compare our FEN (normalized) to Fairy-Stockfish after every ply — 60 games in verify, 400 with PERFT_DEEP=1, all equal.

features.title: Move generation for all pieces
features.user_visible_behavior: The engine lists every pseudo-legal and legal move for Khun, Met, Khon, Ma, Ruea, Bia and promoted Bia.
verification: Unit tests per piece type from hand-built positions.
Illegal moves that leave own Khun in check are excluded.
evidence: 2026-09-13: movegen.test.ts — Khun, Met, White/Black Khon, Ma, Ruea (open + blocked), White/Black Bia (no double step, diagonal-only capture) pass.

2026-09-13: legality tests pass — start position equals Fairy-Stockfish's 23 moves, pinned Ma has no moves, Khun cannot step into check, only check escapes allowed, Khuns never adjacent, Khon front-square attack.
2026-09-13: lock-step legal move sets equal Fairy-Stockfish on every ply of 400 random games (PERFT_DEEP=1).

features.title: Check, checkmate, stalemate, repetition
features.user_visible_behavior: The engine reports check, checkmate (win), stalemate (draw) and threefold repetition (draw).
verification: Unit tests with known mate, stalemate and repetition positions.
evidence: 2026-09-13: rules.test.ts — checkmate (status + SAN '#'), check SAN '+', stalemate draw, threefold repetition after 8 knight plies (FEN matches Fairy-Stockfish 'w - - 8 5'), undo restores FEN, IllegalMoveError on bad input.

2026-09-13: insufficient-material draws mirror Fairy-Stockfish has_insufficient_material (5 draw + 4 playable cases); found and fixed via lock-step game seed 1 mismatch; game-over flag now equals ffish isGameOver(claimDraw) on every ply of 400 games.

features.title: Bia promotion
features.user_visible_behavior: A Bia reaching the opponent's third rank becomes a promoted Bia that moves like a Met.
verification: Unit tests for promotion by push and by capture, for both colors.
evidence: 2026-09-13: rules.test.ts — White push (a6=M) and capture promotion, Black push and capture promotion, promoted Bia moves like a Met, undo reverts to Bia; all pass.
2026-09-13: perft fixtures 'pawn race with promotions' (depth 6 = 124748) and 'promoted met present' (depth 5 = 21334) match Fairy-Stockfish.

features.title: Counting rules (Sak Kradan and Sak Mak)
features.user_visible_behavior: When counting rules apply, the engine tracks the count and declares a draw when the limit is reached.
verification: Scenario tests for board's-honour counting (no Bia left, limit 64).
Scenario tests for pieces'-honour limits: 2 Ruea 8, 1 Ruea 16, 2 Khon 22, 2 Ma 32, 1 Khon 44, otherwise 64.
Results cross-checked against Fairy-Stockfish makruk for the same move sequences.
evidence: 2026-09-13: rules.test.ts counting suite passes — K+R vs K FENs '32 6' → '32 7', board's honour '128 0', promotion start '128 6' (all identical to ffish probe output), 7 pieces'-honour limit cases, no counting with Bia, draw when count exceeds limit, mate on limit move still wins, lone Khun capturing last Bia starts at 2n-1.

2026-09-13: lock-step random games (captures preferred so endgames are reached) compare counting FEN fields and game-over with Fairy-Stockfish on every ply; test asserts counting plies > 0; 400 games pass with PERFT_DEEP=1.

features.title: Perft verification against Fairy-Stockfish
features.user_visible_behavior: Engine move counts match the reference engine, so rules cannot silently drift.
verification: Perft depth 1-5 from the start position matches Fairy-Stockfish.
Perft depth 1-4 from 5+ tricky positions matches Fairy-Stockfish.
Perft tests run in npm run verify (fast depths) and a slower script (deep depths).
evidence: 2026-09-13: reference counts generated by scripts/perft-reference.cjs from ffish@0.7.10 into src/testing/perft-reference.json: start 23 / 529 / 12012 / 273026 / 6223994.

2026-09-13: npm test -w packages/engine → 129 passed (fast depths ≤150k nodes), 9 deep skipped; npm run test:deep → 138 passed in 12s incl. start depth 5 and 11 other positions (check block, khon/met, counting endgame, promotions, 6 random midgames) at depth 4-6.
